title: okf-strategy — numeric series sidecar (OKF-Strategy profile v1.0)
description: The analytical sidecar data/<object>-<id>-series.json referenced by cps.measure.dataResource (SPEC §6.1). Columnar: one shared, ascending period axis, and one value array per series aligned to it by index. Not a concept — it has no frontmatter and no `type`.

concept.description: Concept ID (bundle-relative path minus .md) of the element that owns this series. Back-reference to the concept whose cps.measure.dataResource points here.

periodicity.description: The element's reporting periodicity (periodGroup NAME), as in cps.periodicity.

periods.description: The shared period axis, oldest first: every period in which at least one series has a value. Every series' values[i] belongs to periods[i].

periodId.description: Period id from the root periods.md lookup; null when the source has none.

period.description: Period name as the source system shows it (e.g. 'Q4-25', '2024', 'FY 2025').

periodDate.description: Last day of the period (valid time). Orders the axis; null only when the source name cannot be dated.

series.description: One entry per series, in the same order as cps.measure.series where that is present.

name.description: Series name; matches a cps.measure.series[].name on the owning concept (e.g. 'Actual', 'Target').

seriesDataTypeId.description: Same codes as cps.measure.series[].seriesDataTypeId. 11 = Text, whose values are strings.

values.description: Raw values aligned to periods by index. null = no value entered for that period.

labels.description: Optional formatted display strings aligned to periods (e.g. '15.6%'), so a reader can quote the value exactly as the source showed it.
